title: Degree-zero restriction square for the Koszul comparison
statement: Let A be a commutative ring, f a finite sequence, U its principal-open union, E in D_QCoh(Spec A), and F a termwise quasi-coherent cochain complex with i:Q(F) isomorphic to E [def-pc-derived-category]. Let R be derived restriction to U [def-sc-koszul-open-system], H=H^0 on D(A), G=derived affineOpenSections(U), D the Koszul Hom-complex diagram on affineOpenSections(top)(F), and c its canonical comparison to G(E) [def-sc-koszul-cech-comparison-construction]. There are stage equivalences a_e:Hom(I_e,E) equivalent to H(Q(D_e)), and b:Hom(R(O),R(E)) equivalent to H(G(E)), such that whenever R(unit_e) composed with psi equals R(phi), b(psi)=H(c)(H(Q(colimit.ι D e))(a_e(phi))). This asserts identifications and a commuting square, not surjectivity of c or finite-stage representation.

source.place: Proposition 36.9.5 proof, stage derived-Hom identification; Tag 08D1 and equation 36.9.4.1 for the restriction comparison

proof.text: Each extended Koszul tail is bounded above finite free, hence K-projective. Identify its Hom-complex H^0 with derived Hom and transport along the affine derived equivalence and F representing E. Compose with koszulCechHomObjIso to get stage equivalences a.

Restrict the structure object and use evaluation at 1 to identify its derived Hom with H^0 of derived global sections on U. Restriction of scalars along A to Gamma(U,O_U) identifies the underlying groups with H^0 of affineOpenSections.rightDerivedFunctor(E). This gives b.

The explicit cocone fraction formula evaluates a Hom cochain on the ordered exterior basis and divides by the generator product to exponent e+1, with the specified Hom-to-Cech sign. A contracting homotopy on each D(f_j), given by wedge with f_j^(-e-1) times the jth generator, shows that the inverse restricted augmentation followed by phi has these same fractions. The hypothesis R(unit_e) composed with psi equals R(phi) characterizes that composite because the localized augmentation is invertible. Apply the Cech-derived-section comparison and pass to H^0; independence under homotopy and transport along i prove the displayed square. For an empty cover and the zero ring all these objects are zero.

lean.statement:
theorem koszulOpenHom_comparison_square
    (A : Type uMain) [CommRing A] (r : ℕ) (f : Fin r → A)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wMain}
      (SheafOfModules.{uMain} (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ V : (Spec (.of A)).Opens, HasDerivedCategory.{wMain}
      (SheafOfModules.{uMain} ((moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace).over V))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wMain}
      (SheafOfModules.{uMain} (moduleRings (koszulOpen A r f).toScheme.toRingedSpace))]
    (E : schemeDerivedQCohCategory (Spec (.of A)))
    [HasDerivedCategory.{vMain} (ModuleCat.{uMain} A)]
    (F : CochainComplex
      (SheafOfModules.{uMain} (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    (hF : ∀ n : ℤ, (F.X n).IsQuasicoherent)
    (i : DerivedCategory.Q.obj F ≅ E.obj) :
    let R := ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{uMain}
      (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace) (koszulOpen A r f)) ⋙
      Equivalence.functor
        (C := SheafOfModules.{uMain}
          ((moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace).over (koszulOpen A r f)))
        (D := SheafOfModules.{uMain}
          (moduleRings (koszulOpen A r f).toScheme.toRingedSpace))
        (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv (koszulOpen A r f))).mapDerivedCategory
    let H := DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{uMain} A) 0
    let D := koszulCechHomDiagram A r f
      (((affineOpenSections A ⊤).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj F)
    let G := (affineOpenSections A (koszulOpen A r f)).rightDerivedFunctor
    let c := koszulCechDerivedComparison A r f F ≫ G.map i.hom
    ∃ (a : ∀ e : ℕ, (koszulOpenObject A r f e ⟶ E.obj) ≃
          H.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (D.obj e)))
      (b : (R.obj (koszulOpenStructure A) ⟶ R.obj E.obj) ≃ H.obj (G.obj E.obj)),
      ∀ (e : ℕ) (φ : koszulOpenObject A r f e ⟶ E.obj)
        (ψ : R.obj (koszulOpenStructure A) ⟶ R.obj E.obj),
        R.map (koszulOpenUnit A r f e) ≫ ψ = R.map φ →
        b ψ = H.map c (H.map (DerivedCategory.Q.map (colimit.ι D e)) (a e φ))
